title: QE template/custom_evo runtime metadata leaks into strategy_params and fails V2 strategy whitelist
description:
Expected: QE template/custom_evo archive_policy, archive_reason, archive_allow_override, and random_seed are runtime metadata stored in runtime_flags or explicit metadata fields, and never passed to Qlib strategy constructors. QE MCP-created custom_evo templates using SuspendFilterScoreWeightedTopkStrategyV2 should materialize and run without strategy whitelist failures.
Actual: the custom_evo template materializer injected template archive policy into each loop's strategy_params. Caller-supplied random_seed could also remain inside strategy_params. The unified config composer merged these values into strategy kwargs and raised ValueError for unsupported parameters ['archive_policy', 'random_seed']. This is a QE backend runtime-contract bug, not an MCP wrapper bug.

trigger_condition.entrypoint: QE MCP qe_template_create/materialize/run -> /qe-templates -> custom_evo unified loop

reproduce_command: Create a custom_evo QE execution template with archive_policy=AUTO and a loop using SuspendFilterScoreWeightedTopkStrategyV2. Put random_seed in loop.strategy_params. Approve, materialize, and run it; before the fix config_composer raised ValueError for unsupported strategy params ['archive_policy', 'random_seed'].
closure_requirements: template custom_evo materializer writes archive metadata to runtime_flags, not strategy_params
strategy_params archive/seed metadata is hoisted or stripped before executable config composition
V2 strategy whitelist remains strict and is not broadened to hide metadata leaks
runtime_flags preserve archive/seed metadata for QE Archive and Research Pipeline visibility
GitHub issue #91 is updated with branch, commit, PR, and validation evidence
